div.p: Can't find what you need? Ask an agent

div.dt: Do I pay a fee to Propelle as a tenant?
div.dd: No. Our fee is paid by the landlord. You pay the rent, the security deposit and, for some buildings, an application fee set by the building.

div.dt: How much is the security deposit?
div.dd: Usually one month's rent, sometimes two for furnished homes. It's held separately and returned after you move out, minus any agreed deductions.

div.dt: Can I rent for less than a year?
div.dd: Many of our furnished homes are available for one to six months. Unfurnished homes are normally let on 12-month leases.
It depends on the landlord. About half our rentals accept pets, sometimes with an extra deposit. Ask your agent and we'll filter the list for you.

div.dt: What if I don't meet the income requirement?
div.dd: You can usually add a guarantor, or offer extra months of rent up front. We'll tell you what each landlord will accept before you apply.
